szoveg_eredeti:
VIDEO. From the Half Moon Bay City Council Regular Meeting on Tuesday, October 20th, 2026 at 7:00pm, as a hybrid meeting, with remote comment. Agenda and AI Policy. Staff Report for Item #11C: “Receive a report on the City’s draft Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy, the work of the internal AI Subcommittee, and the AI capability hosted on City infrastructure, and provide staff with feedback and direction on the draft policy and use of AI.”

On Wednesday, October 21st, the day after the City Council meeting, as an “opt-in subscriber” I received this message. The City website is up again. The e-mail notification webpage link has been disabled (…Read on)

This was a world-wide attack on the PHP programming language. If the City had PHP version 8.3, or after, everything was ok.

Coastside Buzz remained live with no interruption as our PHP is regularly updated.

More on the Half Moon Bay City Council on Coastside Buzz

The City Council of Half Moon Bay is the City’s governing body, and consists of five elected members. The Council sets priorities and policies, makes final decisions on all major City matters, adopts ordinances and resolutions, appoints the City Manager and City Attorney, and approves the annual budget.

The Half Moon Bay City Council typically meets on the first and third Tuesday of each month starting at 7:00pm at the Ted Adcock Community Center, 535 Kelly Avenue.
